info.title: shubAstro APIs
info.description:
shubAstro APIs power user-astrologer interactions, orders, and payments.
Includes chat, call sessions, kundli, blogs, and utility endpoints for the platform.

BearerAuth.name: Authorization
BearerAuth.description: Enter your Bearer token in the format: Bearer <token>

get.summary: Generate invoice PDF or transaction statement (User & Astrologer)
get.description: Works for both User and Astrologer tokens. The role is auto-detected from JWT. Three modes: (1) Single transaction invoice (user perspective) — shows debit amount. (2) Single transaction invoice (astrologer perspective) — shows credit/earning amount with platform commission. (3) Date range statement — pass startDate and endDate. post.description:
Generates a single-page, consultation-grade business report from the user\'s birth chart + chip-based business inputs (category, scale, partnership, timeline).

Birth chart resolution (two modes):
1. kundliId (recommended) — a 24-char hex ObjectId of a saved kundli. When provided, the authoritative birth profile + astro snapshot are loaded from the DB. Requires a valid Bearer token (the kundli must belong to the authenticated user); otherwise returns 401. If the id is not found / not owned, returns 404 KUNDLI_NOT_FOUND.
2. Inline birth details — used when kundliId is omitted (name, gender, day, month, year, hour, min, place, lat, lon, tzone, etc.).

The chip fields (businessCategory, scale, partnership, timeline) are validated against the live options from GET /options.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Provide business inputs plus EITHER kundliId (authoritative, from DB) OR inline birth details.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — invalid chip values or malformed kundliId (must be 24-char hex).

404.description: KUNDLI_NOT_FOUND — kundliId does not exist or is not accessible to the user.

get.description: Returns active spaces the authenticated user belongs to, each annotated with isJoined:true, myRole, and joinedAt.

get.summary: Get a single space by slug or id

post.description: Idempotent — already-active members get { alreadyMember: true }. A previously-left membership row is reactivated (no new row). Banned users are rejected with 403. Increments space.memberCount on first join / reactivation.

Soft-leaves the space — sets membership.status = "left" (row preserved for re-join). Decrements space.memberCount. The user can still see their existing posts in this space via /community/library?tab=my-posts but can no longer post new content until they rejoin.

get.description: Returns posts grouped by the caller\'s relationship to them. tab=all (default, union of my-posts+liked+commented, deduped) | tab=my-posts (posts I authored — includes hidden/reported so I see moderator actions, my own identity is NOT stripped on anonymous posts) | tab=liked (posts I\'ve liked, active only) | tab=commented (posts I\'ve commented on, active only). Response shape matches the feed: each post carries authorName, authorImage, spaceInfo (null for unscoped feed-composer posts), isLiked, counters.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Which slice of my activity to return

200.description: Library posts. spaceInfo is null for unscoped posts created via the feed composer.

body.example: Sharing a thought from the feed.

get.description: Fetch a single post by ID. Returns 404 if the post is hidden/reported/deleted (only status=active is exposed). Response includes spaceInfo (populated), authorName, authorImage, isVerifiedAuthor. Optional auth fills isLiked.

patch.description: Update an existing post (author only). Partial update — send only the fields you want to change. At least one of title, body, images, linkedProducts is required. New/changed title or body is re-moderated via AWS Bedrock; newly-added images run through AWS Rekognition (existing images are not re-scanned).

body.example: Here is what I learned about Saturn remedies last week — try lighting a mustard oil diya every Saturday.

400.description: Validation failure or content blocked by Bedrock/Rekognition

404.description: Post not found or not authored by caller

delete.description: Soft-delete a post. Only the author can delete their own post.

post.description: Constraints: body 20-5000 chars; title up to 200 chars; max 5 images. spaceId is OPTIONAL — omit (or send null/"") to create an unscoped global post (the feed-composer flow). When spaceId is set, the caller MUST be an active member of that space; astrologers are rate-limited to 2 posts/week per space. Title+body run through AWS Bedrock moderation; each image runs through AWS Rekognition (both parallel). Content that fails moderation is rejected with 400. For Confessions-type spaces (forceAnonymous), the post is forced anonymous regardless of the request flag. Anonymous posts on unscoped (no space) requests are allowed.

body.example: Here is what I learned about Saturn remedies last week — try lighting a mustard oil diya every Saturday.

400.description: Validation failure, content blocked by Bedrock/Rekognition, or anonymous-not-permitted in this space

403.description: User must join this space before posting

429.description: Astrologer rate limit hit: max 2 posts/week per space

post.summary: Toggle like on post or comment
post.description: Like or unlike a post or comment — calling again on the same target toggles it off. Returns { liked: true|false, likesCount }. A LIKE on a post (not on a comment, not self-like) fires a push notification to the post author.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: targetType must be post or comment

200.description: Liked or Unliked, with updated count

post.description: Top-level comment if parentId omitted; reply if parentId is any active comment on this post. Nesting depth is unlimited — replies can be made to replies, etc. Body runs through AWS Bedrock moderation — flagged content returns 400. Inherits anonymity policy from the parent post\'s space: forceAnonymous spaces flip isAnonymous to true automatically; spaces that don\'t allow anonymity reject isAnonymous=true. Anonymous comments on unscoped (no-space) posts are rejected. Astrologer comments get isVerifiedAuthor=true if their account is manually verified. Fires a push notification to the post author (top-level) or parent comment author (reply).

400.description: Body fails Bedrock moderation, reply nesting > 2 levels, or anonymous comment on unscoped/non-permitting space

404.description: Post or parent comment not found

get.description: Returns top-level comments with replies nested under each (arbitrary depth — replies array per comment). Every node carries authorName + authorImage (null for customers, profile picture for astrologers). Anonymous comments are sanitized for EVERY viewer (authorId=null, authorType=ANONYMOUS, authorName=null, authorImage=null) — even the author of the anonymous comment sees themselves stripped here. Astrologer comments carry isVerifiedAuthor=true. Optional auth fills isLiked.

200.description: Top-level comments with replies nested. Anonymous comments stripped of identity. authorImage is null for customers (no profile image on the user model).

body.example: Tried this last Saturday. Felt lighter.
Same! How long did you do it for?
